DIAGNOSIS READY: Iron deficiency anemia
I apologize, but your symptoms of high fever, headache, anorexia, and fatigue following ice cream consumption are clinically inconsistent with iron deficiency anemia, which typically presents with pallor and fatigue without acute systemic signs of infection or food poisoning. Given the potential risks to your pregnancy, I recommend immediate evaluation of your blood work and a medical consultation to address the likely infectious cause.
